Mimi's mother was the cruellest and most talented of her clan and raised Mimi to be a worthy Witch, however she began to have doubts over her role after carrying out an assassination on behalf of the clan and realising her mother cared little for her.

When Mimi resolved to leave the Witches' clan to travel the world as a human, her mother cast a curse on her which permanently robbed her of mana, and with it her ability to cast magic. Years after her exile, Mimi realised witches did not age like normal humans did and she was shunned and mistrusted, eventually persecuted when humans discovered her true identity and sought to kill her.

When Mimi chose to end her life after tiring of wandering the earth as a hunted ex-witch, she was saved by Tanya who encountered her by chance after she'd stabbed herself with a poisoned dagger. Mimi's name was given to her by Tanya as she had forgotten her own after years of wandering, Tanya chose it as Mimi's characteristic hood made her look like she had cat ears.

When Mimi resolves to open the portal to her homeland, she asks Lille and Tanya alone as word of her identity would have forced her to run from the village. Fortunately for her both of them accept her for who she is, something she is eternally grateful for.
The hierarchical superior of Mio and all the other nurses. Her slogan is "professionalism, efficiency and rigor" and beware of those who can't keep these goals.
Serious and strict with her younger nurse colleagues who only think about marrying young single doctors, she is more friendly during breaks.

She manages to judge someone right at first sight and she knows that Mio isn't the type of woman to jump on the first single doctor to come. Although she asks her to be more serious at work, she is actually very curious with her doctor colleague about the romance between Takuya and Mio.

Aki is the younger of Boku's twin sisters. Boku refers to her as the "cheeky", selfish imouto.

Aki was originally in love with Boku's now-deceased older brother (referred to as Ichi-niichan), whom she viewed as a very responsible and incredible person. Thus, she in part wants Boku to be like him, but decides to make fun of him for being an otaku and a ronin. She's not as merciful as An is, which often puts her and Boku at odds with each other. They do get along through their common interested in anime, as she herself is a fan (and a cosplayer). Aki is also a lot more open when it comes to talking about sexually themed things like eroge, much to our protagonist and An's dismay.

Unlike the rest of the cast, Aki is very detached from the events of the game, basically doing her own thing while studying to be a voice actress. Just like An, she moves in with Boku to make sure things are alright with our protagonist, but also because there's a nearby acting school that she wants to attend.

A point of interest is that due to Aki's low level of interaction with the other characters, it is through her work that the protagonist develops feelings for her. Her talent as a voice actress shines in the story, since she is contracted to be a VA for "Ai kawarazu na boku". Much to Aki's chagrin, Boku prefers to see her act as the innocent and cute imouto (which is nowhere near what her real personality is).
